request_fields: Definition (task instruction listing the 10 hallmarks) + instance input (abstract)
notes: MedS-Bench (Wu et al., npj Digit Med 2024; arXiv 2408.12547) recasts the dataset as an instruction task. Henrychur/MedS-Bench holds the full test files ("the official benchmark"); Henrychur/MedS-Bench-SPLIT holds the subsample used for the paper's results. n_items counts the MedS-Bench file. Multi-label abstract classification over the 10 hallmarks. ClinicBench also uses HoC (315 test documents, BLURB split) but does not redistribute items; the 158 MedS-Bench items come from the sb895 release. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: instruction-style (MedS-Bench): the task Definition, a blank line, then the instance input (few-shot examples and outputs omitted)
rendering.template_source: none (instruction and input as released in the MedS-Bench task files)
